title: Single-Pass Nanofilter for Oligosaccharide/Nucleoside Mixes
summary: German researchers are developing a nanofiltration module specifically for glycan purification that, in their experiments, delivers high product recovery rates and lowers production and maintenance costs as well as downtime.The postSingle-Pass Nanofilter for Oligosaccharide/Nucleoside Mixesappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
